summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Semiconductors 2x Daily ETF (XSEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (Ticker: SMH), which provides exposure to US semiconductor stocks. XSEM was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
